output.summary: A medium-sized palm native to South America, the queen palm has feather-like leaves typically bearing around 300 leaflets. Its ripe fruit has sweet, orange, sticky flesh and is sometimes eaten; young buds are eaten as vegetables, pickled or preserved in oil.
output.edibilityNote: Ripe fruits are sometimes eaten; unexpanded leaves and young buds are consumed, with buds also pickled or preserved in oil.
